Fixture v1.3 matches design 3.2 exactly (version, auto-escalation body, new node, e10 retarget, e18, description without banned phrase), YAML parity done without body_template as designed; seed header v1.3. No behaviours/macros/plumbing added; two small private helpers in engine.ex (validate_rendered_url_or_error, render_body_or_error) are refactor-for-with, not abstraction; no extra public API beyond design section 4 table. The only rescue (stringify_value map/list clause) is justified: Jason.encode/2 returns {:error,_} for EncodeError but raises Protocol.UndefinedError for non-encodable terms such as tuples, and INV-8/design 2.2 require never raising. T8 rewritten to the strictly stronger new contract (inbound/outbound edges of both nodes, decoded body equality, node type, same endpoint) rather than loosened; M9 mutant replaced by M9a/M9b/M9c as design 6.3 prescribes, each still asserts {:error,_}.
